positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Developed a year long project focused on the formation of an efficient combinatorial algorithm to build upon current research regarding co-phylogeny mapping of host and parasite trees
•	Present project updates during computational biology laboratory meetings

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Facilitate lab sections by presenting lab material and aiding in the design and construction of both combinational and sequential logic circuits on LogicWorks and hardware
•	Hold weekly office hours to grade laboratory assignments, troubleshoot student circuits, and answer questions to ensure students understand course material

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Compiled test data by importing from LabView into Excel for analysis by company executives
•	Transferred company history of over 300 bearing tests from test reports into a searchable Access database to allow supervisors to quickly pinpoint tests similar to current projects
